description: Machine-readable mapping of TracingInsights 2026 JSON output fields.

wT.description: Session time when this weather sample was recorded from the start of session

wAT.description: Ambient air temperature around the track

wR.description: Boolean flag indicating whether it was raining at this moment

wWD.description: Direction the wind is coming from, measured as compass bearing

wWS.description: How fast the wind is blowing

time.description: Session time when this message was issued

status.description: Additional context about the message state

flag.description: Type of flag being waved (if applicable)

scope.description: How wide the impact of this message is

sector.description: Which mini sector is affected (if scope is "Sector") There are 3 sectors, each divided into 8 mini sectors

dNum.description: The driver's car number affected by the message (if scope is "Driver")

lap.description: Which lap number this message refers to

time.description: Time when this data sample was recorded from start of the lap

rpm.notes: Notes: Higher on straights, lower in corners

speed.description: How fast the car is traveling

gear.description: Current gear the car is in

throttle.description: How much the driver is pressing the throttle pedal

brake.notes: Notes: Binary: either braking or not

drs.description: Status of DRS (rear wing flap that reduces drag). The raw FastF1 value is mapped to a binary open/closed state.
drs.notes: Notes: 0 = Off/closed; 1 = open. Raw FastF1 DRS values of 10, 12, or 14 are treated as open.

distance.description: Total distance driven since start of lap

rel_distance.description: Normalized distance along the lap, where 0.0 is the first sample and 1.0 is the last sample.
rel_distance.notes: Notes: Useful for aligning telemetry across different laps.

DriverAhead.description: The car number of the driver directly ahead in the race order

DistanceToDriverAhead.description: How far behind the next car is

acc_x.notes: Computation Formula: ax = gradient(v_ms) / gradient(time) where v_ms = speed / 3.6; Outlier Handling: If ax > 25 m/s² (one-sided, positive only), value is replaced with previous sample's value. Boundary samples (first/last) are excluded.; Smoothing: 3-point moving average

acc_y.notes: Computation Formula: ay = v² × C where C = dθ / (ds + 0.0001), θ = arctan2(dy, dx), phase-unwrapped; Outlier Handling: Stage 1 (intermediate): if |dθ| > 0.5 rad/sample, replace with previous value before computing C and ay. Stage 2: hard-zero if |ay| > 150 m/s² (~15G); Smoothing: 9-point moving average

acc_z.notes: Computation Formula: az = v² × C_z where C_z = dθ_z / (ds + 0.0001), θ_z = arctan2(dz, dx), phase-unwrapped; Outlier Handling: Stage 1 (intermediate): if |dθ_z| > 0.5 rad/sample, replace with previous value. Stage 2: hard-zero if |az| > 150 m/s² (~15G); Smoothing: 9-point moving average

z.notes: Details: Curbs, jumps, and elevation changes

dataKey.description: Unique identifier that links this telemetry data to a specific driver and lap

team.description: Team name the driver is racing for

tc.description: Official team color in hexadecimal format

url.description: Web link to the driver's official headshot photo

time.description: The actual lap time for this lap
time.notes: Notes: For Race sessions this is overwritten with the official Ergast/Jolpica lap time when available.

sesT.description: When this lap ended relative to session start

lST.description: When this lap started relative to session start
lST.notes: Notes: Lap ended at "sesT", started at "lST"

s1.description: Time to complete first section of track

s2.description: Time to complete second section of track

s3.description: Time to complete final section of track

s1T.description: Session time when the Sector 1 time was set relative to session start

s2T.description: Session time when the Sector 2 time was set relative to session start

s3T.description: Session time when the Sector 3 time was set relative to session start

vi1.description: Top speed measured at speed trap in Sector 1

vi2.description: Top speed measured at speed trap in Sector 2

vfl.description: Top speed measured at the finish line

vst.description: Top speed measured on the longest straight

compound.description: The type of tire being used

life.description: Laps driven on this tire (includes laps in other sessions for used sets of tires)

fresh.description: Was this a new (fresh) tire when fitted?
fresh.values: true = new tire, false = used tire. Tyre had TyreLife=0 at stint start, i.e. was a new tire

stint.description: How many pit stops has this driver made
stint.values: First stint = 1, after 1st pit stop = 2, etc.

qs.description: Which qualifying segment this lap belongs to (Qualifying / Sprint Qualifying only)

pos.description: Driver's position in the race/sprint at the end of this lap. Position of the driver at the end of each lap. This value is "None" for FP1, FP2, FP3, Sprint Shootout, and Qualifying as well as for crash laps. For Race sessions this may be overwritten with the Ergast/Jolpica position when available.

status.description: A string that contains track status numbers for all track status that occurred during this lap.

pb.description: Indicates whether this lap is the official personal best lap of a driver. If any lap of a driver is quicker than their respective personal best lap, this means that the quicker lap is invalid and not counted. For example, this can happen if the track limits were exceeded.

pin.description: When the driver entered the pit lane relative to session start
pin.notes: Notes: "None" if this wasn't an in-lap

pout.description: When the driver exited the pit lane relative to session start
pout.notes: Notes: "None" if this wasn't an out-lap

iacc.description: Is this lap timing data considered accurate?
iacc.notes: Notes: Indicates that the lap start and end time are synced correctly with other laps. Do not confuse this with the accuracy of the lap time or sector times. They are always considered to be accurate if they exist! If this value is true, the lap has passed as basic accuracy check for timing data. This does not guarantee accuracy but laps marked as inaccurate need to be handled with caution. They might contain errors which can not be spotted easily.

ff1G.description: Indicates that this lap was added by FastF1. Such a lap will generally have very limited information available and information is partly interpolated or based on reasonable assumptions. Cases were this is used are, for example, when a partial last lap is added for drivers that retired on track.
ff1G.notes: Notes: true means some missing data was filled in

del.description: Indicates that a lap was deleted by the stewards, for example because of a track limits violation.

delR.description: Gives the reason for a lap time deletion.

wT.description: Session time when this weather sample was recorded

wAT.description: Ambient air temperature around the track

wR.description: Boolean flag indicating whether it was raining

wWD.description: Direction the wind is coming from, measured as compass bearing

wWS.description: How fast the wind is blowing

X.description: Horizontal position of the corner on the track map

Y.description: Horizontal position of the corner on the track map

Angle.description: is an angle in degrees, used to visually offset the marker’s placement on a track map in a logical direction (usually orthogonal to the track).

Distance.description: Location of the marker as a distance from the start/finish line.

Rotation.description: Rotation of the circuit in degrees. This can be used to rotate the coordinate system of the telemetry (position) data to match the orientation of the official track map.
